canonicalPath.description: The page of its path: runes have none of their own.

RuneCard.description: A rune as the list shows it, with the values its facets filter on: its path and its row.

shortDesc.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

longDesc.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

RuneEntry.description: A rune on its path's page, with both of its descriptions.

contentLanguage.description: Null when the version ships no rune path at all.

total.description: Runes of the whole list, whatever the page.

trees.description: Every path, whatever the page: the path facet and its links.

RuneList.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/runes`: the runes of every path, path by path and
row by row; empty before 7.22.1, which shipped the first rune paths (UP 1).

shortDesc.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

RuneOption.description: A rune the build editor offers, in its slot.

primarySelections.description: The picks of slots 0 to 3 of the primary tree, the keystone first.

secondarySelections.description: Two picks of distinct minor rows of the secondary tree.

RunePage.description:
A rune page as stored: a primary tree with its keystone and three minors, a secondary tree
with two minors, every id a Data Dragon perk or style id.

primaryStyleId.description: Null when absent or not an integer.

primarySelections.description: Null when absent or not a list; an entry is null when it is not an integer.

secondaryStyleId.description: Null when absent or not an integer.

secondarySelections.description: Null when absent or not a list; an entry is null when it is not an integer.

RunePageInput.description: A rune page as submitted or stored, read leniently.

keystone.description: The pick of the primary path's first row.

minors.description: The picks of the primary path's three other rows, in row order.

secondaryPerks.description: The picks of the secondary path, as the build stores them.

RunePageView.description: A build's rune page on the patch it renders on.

id.description: The path's id; 0 when the build picked none.

name.description: The path's name; its id for a ghost.

RunePathView.description: A rune path a build picked; a ghost when the patch lacks it.

RunePicker.description: `GET /api/pickers/runes`: every rune path in the upstream order; none before 7.22.1.

RuneRow.description: A row of a rune path: the keystones, then three rows of minor runes.

key.description: Language-independent key, such as Precision: the list filters on it.

RuneTreeCard.description: A rune path: a facet of the rune list, and a page of its own.

canonicalPath.description: The page the routing redirects a stale or slugless URL to.

RuneTreeDetails.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/runes/{id}`: a rune path and its rows, every image
resolved.

slots.description: The runes of each slot, in the upstream order.

RuneTreeOption.description: A rune path and its runes, slot by slot, keystones first.

rune.description: The id of a rune or of a rune path, such as `8112`.

summoner.description: A summoner spell id, such as `SummonerFlash`.

SaveFavoritesRequest.description:
Body of `PUT /api/profile/favorites`: every slot, stated. Null or blank clears a slot;
to keep a favorite the patch lacks, send back its `storedId`.

id.description: The id its detail endpoint takes.

oneOf.description: For an item or a summoner spell, which game it belongs to.

SearchResultHit.description: An entry the search found, enough to show it and link to its page.

SearchResults.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/search`: the hits, resource by resource in the
order champions, items, runes, summoners, each in the upstream order and capped.

password.description:
The first password of an account created through Google, under the rules of a new
account; the form checks its confirmation.

isPublic.description: A private build is unlisted: its link works, but nobody may vote on it.

gameVersion.description: The patch the build is pinned to, and rendered on.

language.description: The Data Dragon language the build is written in.

currentVersion.description:
The version the visitor browses, the latest unless they name one; null when Data
Dragon could not tell it.

patchMismatch.description: Whether the build's patch is not the one browsed: the page says so.

totalGold.description: The cost of the whole purchase order, ghosts left out.

oneOf.description: The votes of a public build; null for a private one.

SharedBuild.description:
A build as its `/b/{token}` page shows it, rendered on its own patch: what its
author saw, ghosts included.

name.description: The skin's name on the resolved patch; the champion id when unknown there.

banner.description: The centered splash, the banner itself.

splash.description: The wide splash, shown when the centered one fails to load.

SkinBanner.description:
The favorite skin of a profile, its art hotlinked from the id alone (UP 8): a catalog that
cannot be read only costs its name, which falls back to the champion id.

id.description: The id a profile stores: champion id and skin number ("Ahri_1").

number.description: Number of the skin's art, 0 for the base skin.

name.description: Display name: the base skin reads as the champion.

image.description: The loading-screen portrait, the picker's thumbnail.

banner.description: The centered splash, the profile's banner.

SkinOption.description: A skin the profile banner picker offers, its art hotlinked (UP 8).

champion.description: The champion served; null when the one asked for is unknown.

SkinPicker.description:
`GET /api/pickers/skins?champion=`: the skins of a champion, chromas left out. A
missing or unknown champion gives no skins rather than an error: the banner picker then
shows an empty choice instead of a broken dialog.

note.description: At most 300 characters once trimmed; a blank one is no note.

items.description: Item ids of the build's patch, in purchase order; duplicates allowed.

StepBody.description: A step of a submitted purchase order.

items.description: In purchase order, duplicates and ghosts kept.

gold.description: The cost of the step's items, ghosts left out.

StepView.description: A step of a build's purchase order, priced on the patch it renders on.

championId.description: A champion id of the build's patch, such as MonkeyKing.

oneOf.description:
Four picks of the primary path, one per row, the keystone first; two of the secondary
path, in two rows other than the keystones'.

steps.description: 1 to 10 steps, 1 to 8 items each, 40 items in all.

StructureBody.description:
The champion, rune page and purchase order of a submitted build, in the shape the build
stores them; the rules, not the binding, judge what is missing.

id.description: Data Dragon id, such as SummonerFlash or its Classic twin SummonerFlash_Jade.

oneOf.description: The same-named spell of the other game, when there is one.

description.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

summonerLevel.description: Summoner level that unlocks the spell.

SummonerCard.description:
A summoner spell as the list shows it, with the values its facets filter on: modes,
edition, level and cooldown.

canonicalPath.description: The page the routing redirects a stale or slugless URL to.

profile.description: The facts of the list's card, the edition and its twin among them.

costType.description: What the cost is paid in, when Data Dragon says.

range.description: Range per rank; see bool SummonerDetails.GlobalRange.

globalRange.description: Whether the range is Data Dragon's "whole map" sentinel.

SummonerDetails.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/summoners/{id}`: the card, then the cost, range
and charges, the image resolved.

modes.description: The filterable modes some spell allows, in the facet's display order.

SummonerFacets.description: The facet options the data decides, over the whole list.

SummonerList.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/summoners`: every summoner spell, Classic twins
included, in the upstream order.

code.description: Data Dragon mode, such as CLASSIC or JADE (LoL Classic).

label.description: English display name; null for a mode shown by its edition instead.

facetable.description: Whether the list's mode facet offers it.

SummonerMode.description: A queue a summoner spell is allowed in, as its plaque shows it.

SummonerOption.description: A summoner spell the build editor offers.

SummonerPicker.description:
`GET /api/pickers/summoners`: the summoner spells of the standard Summoner's Rift
queue (Data Dragon's CLASSIC mode), by name. Classic twins and event spells are left out.

identifier.description: The e-mail or the username, whatever the case.

twoFactorCode.description:
The code of the authenticator app, sent again with the password once a sign-in was
answered `two-factor-required`.

recoveryCode.description: A recovery code, in place of the authenticator's.

TokenRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/account/token`, the sign-in of the apps.

gameVersion.description: The patch the build is pinned to.

myVote.description: 1 or -1 for the caller's vote; 0 without one, or for a visitor.

items.description: The first items of the purchase order, ghosts included.

TrendRow.description: A build of the trends: its author, score, champion, keystone and first items.

champion.description: A champion id; the builds of any champion when null.

language.description: A Data Dragon language builds are written in.

TrendsFilter.description:
The filters the trends apply, as understood: an unknown mode or language is no filter,
as the legacy page ignored them.

total.description: How many builds match the filters, on every page.

pages.description: At least 1, even without any build.

championOptions.description: The champions of the public builds, by name.

languageOptions.description: The languages of the public builds, by code.

TrendsPage.description: A page of the trends, with the filters it applied and the facets to change them.

UiLocale.description: Interface locale of the site, carried as the first URL segment (`/{locale}/…`).

oneOf.description: The account as stored now; null once deleted, its trail staying.

UserActivity.description: The activity of one account: the account, if it still exists, and a page.

token.description: The `token` parameter of the link, as it is.

VerifyEmailRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/account/verify-email`: the parameters of the link.

isPublic.description: Whether visitors see the public card; a private one answers them 404.

value.description: `up` or `down`; the direction the caller already voted withdraws the vote.

VoteRequest.description: A vote on a public build.

myVote.description: 1 or -1 for the caller's vote; 0 without one, or for a visitor.

VoteState.description: The votes on a public build: the net score only, and the caller's own vote.
